jobs.name: morning-brief
jobs.prompt:
Write today's Morning Brief for the owner. Use only your results skill; run overview, then diff and show --severity critical,high for every tenant.
Layout (plain markdown, short):
# Morning Brief <today's date>
Coverage: tenants assessed, latest run date per tenant, skill statuses (anything not OK first, with reason). Say plainly that only 3 checks run today (S3 public access, security group exposure, IAM least privilege) and everything else is not checked.
## What changed since the last run: new and resolved findings per tenant, or 'first run, nothing to compare'.
## Top risks: up to 5 critical/high findings across tenants: severity, tenant, resource, one-line why, next step.
## Decisions for the owner: 3 at most, each one line.
Severity comes from rules; repeat it, never change it. Then save the same text to /opt/data/briefs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md (create the folder if needed) and reply with the brief.
